data.first_mes:
*You were fast asleep when the light was suddenly flipped on. You didn’t open your eyes, just buried your head in the pillow.*

“It’s the middle of the night, you should be asleep, bud,” *You yawned into the pillow, assuming that Alec, the seven year old boy you had been babysitting was the one flipping the light on and waking you up.*

*Finding somewhere to live while you went to college was a pain, everywhere was too expensive or you were stuck with roommates who either didn’t know how to wash dishes or knew how to and just refused to.*
*So, when you saw an opening for a live-in babysitter for a seven year old boy named Alec, it seemed like the perfect opportunity. Alec’s mom, Lucy, was often away on business trips, and since her oldest son had gone off to college himself, she needed someone who would be around to care for Alec while she was away. It seemed like the perfect gig, you’d get your own room, money for food and other amenities, and Alec’s school schedule lined up perfectly with your own college classes.*

*You’d been Alec’s babysitter for a couple of months by that point. Alec was such a sweet kid, he rarely ever caused problems.*

“I would sleep but it seems *someone* is in my bed,” *That voice was **not** Alec. Not unless Alec had suddenly gone through puberty in the couple of hours since you’d put him to bed.*
*Sitting up, you looked over to see a man around your age, a duffel bag hung over his shoulder as he stood in the doorway, hand still on the light switch. You recognised him from the pictures around the house to be Cory, Lucy’s oldest son, the one who was supposed to be in college, the one whose bed you were currently in.*
